backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor defining data types (Subject, Chapter, StudySession, Test, RevisionTopic, Goal, SessionSummary) and public functions for managing subjects, chapters, study sessions, tests, revision schedules, daily goals, and session summaries with blob storage mixin.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting five implemented features: archived chapters for deleted subjects, enhanced AI suggester with timeline/test score prioritization, test performance progress bars, test analytics graphs, and study session summaries with AI formatting.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Comprehensive summaries of all frontend files describing a Spider-Man themed CA Final study tracker with subjects, chapters, study sessions, revision schedules, tests, archived chapters, and AI suggestions.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom CSS variables defining a neutral color palette in OKLCH format for light and dark modes, including sidebar, chart, and destructive color tokens.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point for the CA Final Study Tracker application with root div and module script loading main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: TanStack Router setup defining routes for Dashboard, Study Sessions, Revisions, Tests, Subject Detail, and Archived Chapters pages, all wrapped in Layout component.
frontend/src/components/AddChapterDialog: Dialog component for adding a new chapter to a subject with form fields for chapter name and total topics, using backend actor to persist data.
frontend/src/components/AddRevisionDialo: Dialog component that wraps RevisionForm to add new revision topics. Manages dialog open/close state and triggers success callback after form submission.
frontend/src/components/AddSubjectDialog: Dialog component that wraps SubjectForm to add new subjects. Manages dialog open/close state and triggers success callback after form submission.
frontend/src/components/AddTestDialog.ts: Dialog component that wraps TestForm to add new tests. Receives open state as props and closes dialog on successful form submission.
frontend/src/components/AISuggester.tsx: AI study suggestions component that prioritizes subjects based on low test scores, approaching deadlines, low progress, overdue revisions, and upcoming revisions using multiple data hooks and displaying categorized recommendations with icons.
frontend/src/components/ChapterCard.tsx: Displays chapter progress with a progress bar, allows updating completed topics count, and provides a button to view PDF notes if available. Includes PdfViewer dialog integration.
frontend/src/components/EditSubjectDialo: Dialog component for editing existing subjects using SubjectForm. Receives subject data as props and manages dialog state.
frontend/src/components/ExamCountdown.ts: Displays a countdown timer showing days remaining until CA Final exam (May 1, 2028). Updates hourly with calendar icon and styled display.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: Main application layout with header, navigation menu (Dashboard, Study, Revisions, Tests, Archive), exam countdown, and footer. Uses TanStack Router for navigation with active state highlighting.
frontend/src/components/PdfUploader.tsx: Component for uploading PDF study notes with chapter name input, file validation (PDF only, max 10MB), and progress indicator. Uploads PDFs to backend actor.
frontend/src/components/PdfViewer.tsx: Dialog component that displays PDF notes in an iframe with download functionality. Fetches PDF blob from backend using usePdfBlobs hook and creates object URL for viewing.
frontend/src/components/RevisionForm.tsx: Form for adding revision topics with subject selection, topic input, and scheduled date picker. Submits data to backend actor with date converted to nanoseconds.
frontend/src/components/RevisionSchedule: Displays revision items grouped by overdue, upcoming, and completed status with checkboxes to mark revisions complete. Uses spaced repetition scheduling and allows filtering by completion state.
frontend/src/components/SessionSummaries: Shows a scrollable list of study session summaries for final revision with copy-to-clipboard functionality. Displays loading state and empty state when no summaries exist.
frontend/src/components/StudySessionForm: Form component for logging study sessions with date, subject, hours, topics, and optional summary fields. Saves session data and formatted summaries to the backend.
frontend/src/components/StudySessionHist: Displays a chronologically sorted list of past study sessions showing subject, date, topics covered, and hours studied. Handles loading and error states.
frontend/src/components/SubjectCard.tsx: Card component displaying subject progress with completion percentage, target date, status badges, and action buttons for edit, delete, and view details. Calculates if subject is on track, behind, or overdue.
frontend/src/components/SubjectForm.tsx: Form for adding new subjects or updating completed topics count with validation for name, total topics, and target date. Converts dates to nanosecond timestamps for backend storage.
frontend/src/components/SubjectProgressO: Displays a grid of cards showing progress for all subjects with completion percentages, topic counts, and target dates. Uses useSubjects hook and renders loading/empty states.
frontend/src/components/TestAnalyticsCha: Renders test analytics with two chart views: a line chart showing score timeline over time and a bar chart comparing average scores by subject. Uses recharts library and useCompletedTests hook.
frontend/src/components/TestCard.tsx: Displays individual test details including subject, date, chapters, and score with progress bar. Allows updating test scores for completed tests via actor.updateTestScore.
frontend/src/components/TestForm.tsx: Form component for adding new tests with fields for name, subject, date, total marks, and optional chapters. Submits via actor.addTest and validates inputs.
frontend/src/components/TestHistory.tsx: Displays tests in tabs (all/pending/completed) with subject-wise performance progress bars. Uses multiple test hooks and renders TestCard components in a grid.
frontend/src/components/TodayGoalCard.ts: Card for setting and tracking daily study goals with progress bar. Allows setting a daily topic goal and incrementing progress via actor methods.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Manages the backend actor instance using React Query, creating authenticated or anonymous actors based on Internet Identity state and invalidating dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useArchivedChapters.t: React Query hook that fetches archived chapters from the backend actor, returning chapters, loading state, error, and refetch function.
frontend/src/hooks/useChapters.ts: React Query hook for fetching chapters by subject name; currently returns empty array as backend lacks getChaptersBySubject method.
frontend/src/hooks/useCompletedTests.ts: React Query hook that fetches completed tests from the backend actor, returning tests array, loading state, error, and refetch function.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides Internet Identity authentication context with login/logout functionality, identity management, and status tracking using AuthClient from @dfinity/auth-client.
frontend/src/hooks/usePdfBlobs.ts: React Query hook that fetches PDF blob data for a specific chapter by name from the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/usePendingTests.ts: React Query hook that fetches pending tests from the backend actor, returning tests array, loading state, error, and refetch function.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Empty file indicating queries have been moved to dedicated hooks (useSubjects, useStudySessions, useRevisionSchedule).
frontend/src/hooks/useRevisionSchedule.t: React Query hook that fetches the revision schedule (array of RevisionTopic) from the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useRevisionSuggestion: React Query hook that fetches revision suggestions (string array) from the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useSessionSummaries.t: React Query hook that fetches session summaries (string array) from the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useStudySessions.ts: React Query hook that fetches study sessions from the backend actor, returning sessions array, loading state, error, and refetch function.
frontend/src/hooks/useSubjects.ts: React Query hook that fetches subjects from the backend actor, returning subjects array, loading state, error, and refetch function.
React Query hook that fetches suggested subjects (string array) from the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useTests.ts: React Query hook that fetches all tests from the backend actor, returning tests array, loading state, error, and refetch function.
frontend/src/hooks/useTodayGoal.ts: React Query hook that fetches today's goal (dailyGoal and actual progress) from the backend actor.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with Spider-Man themed color scheme (red/blue) for light and dark modes, including custom CSS variables and web-pattern overlay styling.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that sets up React Query and Internet Identity providers, then renders the App component.
Displays archived chapters from deleted subjects in a grid layout with progress bars, topic counts, and PDF indicators using shadcn/ui components.
frontend/src/pages/Dashboard.tsx: Main dashboard page displaying subject overview with statistics (overall progress, total subjects, completed subjects), Spider-Man logo header, today's goal card, AI suggester, and a grid of subject cards with add subject functionality.
Dedicated page for revision schedule management with a header, add revision button, and the RevisionSchedule component for planning and tracking revision topics.
frontend/src/pages/StudySessionsPage.tsx: Comprehensive study sessions page combining subject progress overview, revision tracking, study session form/history in a two-column layout, and session summaries view with separators between sections.
frontend/src/pages/SubjectDetailPage.tsx: Subject detail page showing chapter-wise progress for a specific subject, with overall progress bar, chapter cards grid, PDF uploader, and functionality to add/manage chapters.
frontend/src/pages/TestsPage.tsx: Tests and results tracking page featuring test analytics chart, test history list, and add test dialog with gradient-styled header.
frontend/src/utils/topicEmojis.ts: Utility function that generates consistent emoji icons for topic names by hashing the topic string and mapping it to a predefined list of 24 study-related emojis.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom theme extensions including OKLCH color system, Inter font family, custom border radius variables, web-themed box shadows, and accordion animation keyframes.
project_state.json: Project state metadata documenting the CA Final study tracker application with architectural notes about needed features (archive system, AI formatter, analytics, countdown timer), Spider-Man theming requirements, and list of existing implemented features.
